issues.title: Add to bag gives no confirmation and no route to checkout

quote.text: Waiting to see if item added to bag.

issues.why: Clicking 'Add to bag' produces no visible change - no toast, no cart count update, no navigation - so users cannot tell the item was added and have no way to proceed to payment. All five participants clicked the button repeatedly and then quit.

fix.summary: Show a confirmation and open a path to checkout after adding an item.
fix.before: Clicking 'Add to bag' leaves the user on the product page with no feedback.
fix.after: On click, add the item to the cart, update the bag icon with a count, show a brief toast ('Added to bag'), and reveal a 'View bag' or 'Checkout' button that navigates to a cart screen with payment fields.

issues.title: Color swatches have no visible labels

quote.text: That blue button should select the color I want.

issues.why: The five color buttons are unlabeled icon-only controls. Users must guess which swatch represents blue, and screen readers announce only 'button'. This caused hesitation and repeated clicks on the same swatch.

fix.summary: Add accessible names and visible labels to each color swatch.
fix.before: Buttons have no aria-label and no text label; color is conveyed only by background color.
fix.after: Give each swatch an aria-label matching the color name (e.g., 'Blue', 'Black', 'White', 'Grey', 'Green') and show the color name as a tooltip or adjacent text label.

issues.title: XXL size button disabled with no explanation

quote.text: Check size guide for medium measurements.

issues.why: The XXL button is disabled but provides no tooltip or inline text explaining why (e.g., 'Out of stock'). Users who need that size may think the control is broken. This also fails WCAG 4.1.2.

fix.summary: Add a tooltip or aria-disabled description explaining the disabled state.
fix.before: Button is disabled with no title or aria-description.
fix.after: button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } /* and add title='XXL - currently unavailable' or aria-describedby pointing to a live region with the reason */

issues.title: Footer links use href='#' instead of real destinations

quote.text: I want to see more of the page to find price and checkout options.

issues.why: Links for Shipping, Returns, Size guide, and Contact point to '#', so users seeking policy details or help find dead ends. This adds friction for users who scroll to the footer looking for checkout information.

fix.summary: Replace placeholder hrefs with real URLs or remove the links.
fix.after: Point each link to its proper page (e.g., /shipping, /returns, /size-guide, /contact) or hide the link until the page exists.

issues.title: Header icons lack text labels
issues.why: Search, account, and bag icons have no visible text labels, forcing users to recall or guess their meaning. Elena clicked 'Tees' in the nav instead of using the search icon.

fix.summary: Add visible text labels or aria-labels to header icon buttons.
fix.before: Icon-only buttons for search, account, and bag.
fix.after: Add aria-label='Search', 'Account', 'Bag' and show text labels on hover/focus or keep them visible at larger breakpoints.

expert.finding: The page is titled checkout but shows only a product hero and navigation; there is no cart, size/color selector, or payment form, so the user cannot tell they are in a checkout flow or progress toward buying the medium blue tee.
expert.suggestion: Replace or supplement this marketing page with an actual checkout UI showing cart contents, size and color options, and a card payment form.

expert.finding: The footer newsletter textbox has placeholder text 'Email address' but no visible label, so if the placeholder disappears on focus the user may not know what information is required.
expert.suggestion: Add a persistent visible label such as 'Email address' above the textbox.

expert.finding: The color swatches (elements 12-16) have no visible labels, so a user cannot confirm which swatch is blue without relying on color perception alone.
expert.suggestion: Add visible text labels or tooltips to each color swatch.

expert.finding: Size XXL (element 23) is disabled with no explanation, which may confuse users about availability and block selection if they need that size.
expert.suggestion: Replace the disabled state with an 'Out of stock' label or remove the option and show a stock message.

expert.finding: The color swatches (buttons 12-16) and size buttons (18-23) have no visible labels, so a user cannot tell which color or size is selected without inferring from styling.
expert.suggestion: Add visible text labels or aria-labels to each color and size button, and clearly indicate the current selection.

expert.finding: The XXL size button (23) is disabled with no explanation, which may confuse users who need that size and prevents them from completing the task.
expert.suggestion: Either enable XXL if available or show a clear 'Out of stock' message next to the disabled button.

expert.finding: A control has no accessible name, so screen readers announce just "button".
expert.suggestion: Give icon-only buttons an aria-label (e.g. aria-label="Close") or visible text.

expert.suggestion: Make interactive elements at least 44×44 px (min-height/min-width or padding).
